content.short: Mantium is a native iOS wallet that allows you to create and mint NFTs directly from your mobile: Take a photo, mint as NFT and sell it.
content.description:
Mantium Wallet is designed to provide a complete and ergonomic solution for managing your tokens and NFTs on the Cardano blockchain.

Mantium Wallet also offers a solution for securely accessing and using the Cardano universe's DApps directly from the Wallet. And very soon, we'll be opening up access to Cardano's advantages to all web 2.0 sites and connected objects.

Mantium Wallet is a 100% native iOS application written in Swift, it takes advantage of all the features of the iPhone : Secure Access Keychain, Face ID, Push Notifications, Widgets, BlueTooth, etc...

Our objective is to create tools and services that everyone will want to use.
